name: tavall-ai
description: Load Tavall AI role skills for Function Catalog-backed orchestration, distributed Tavall work, and exact-head local CI completion.

interface.shortDescription: Tavall role skills, orchestration, and exact-head CI
interface.longDescription: Use Tavall AI role skills to coordinate one session with specialized role agents and escalate through the Tavall scheduler only when a separate worker/session is justified. Function tools come from the authorized Function Catalog surface; Tavall Cloud remains the placement, workspace, process-isolation, resource, and local-CI authority. Diff-producing Tavall engineering runs require durable exact-head local CI before completion.
defaultPrompt: Use the Tavall AI orchestration skill for substantive Tavall repository work
Prefer multiple specialized Tavall agents inside the current session when they can safely share the owning workspace
Use the scheduler role only for distributed worker/top-level-session placement and never for implementation itself
Treat Function Catalog functions as the callable capability surface and Tavall Cloud as machine/workspace/process/local-CI authority
Commit and push meaningful mutation checkpoints so distributed recovery can resume from Git rather than unpublished workstation state
Before completing any diff-producing Tavall engineering run, use the bundled tavall-local-ci skill to submit durable profile=all validation for the exact final HEAD
